policies.lockedHint: Chosen when the company was created; changing it would re-value history.

hints.costingMethod: How issues are costed; fixed once the company exists.
hints.costingScope: One cost pool for the company, or one per warehouse; fixed once the company exists.
hints.negativeStockPolicy: What happens when a movement would take stock below zero.
hints.taxRoundingMode: Round tax per line or once per document.
hints.roundingMode: How halves round in money amounts.
hints.bankRevaluationMode: Month-end revaluation of foreign-currency bank balances.
hints.defaultLanguage: The language documents are printed in by default.

companies.description: Legal entities, their currencies, calendars and custom fields.
companies.currencyLocked: Cannot change once the company exists.
companies.emptyDescription: Create the first legal entity to start posting.

routines.pageDescription: Recurring journals and deferral schedules, and the daily routine that posts what is due (auto-reversals, recurring journals, deferral releases).
routines.noRuns: The routines have not run for this company yet.
routines.showItems: Show what the run of {date} did
routines.hideItems: Hide what the run of {date} did
routines.ran: Routine run: {reversals} auto-reversals, {recurring} recurring journals, {deferrals} deferral postings.
routines.name: Name
routines.cronHint: Five-field cron in the company's time zone: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. "0 0 1 * *" is the 1st of every month.

amountModeHints.fixed: Every run posts the same amounts; debits must equal credits.
amountModeHints.variable: The lines give the split; the amount is entered when the journal is generated.
amountModeHints.percentage: Line amounts are percentages of a base amount given on the template or at the run.

routines.autoReverse: Reverse on the first day of the next period
routines.noTemplatesHint: Rent, subscriptions and other journals that repeat on a schedule.

kindHints.prepayment: Paid in advance: each period moves its share from the balance account (e.g. prepaid expenses) to the expense account.
kindHints.accrual: Incurred before it is billed: each period books its share to the expense account against the accrual.
kindHints.deferred_revenue: Billed in advance: each period releases its share from deferred revenue to revenue.

routines.noDeferralsHint: Prepaid insurance, annual licences, accrued bonuses and revenue billed in advance.

itemCost.title: Item cost
itemCost.openHint: Double-click a row to see how the item is costed and, under standard cost, set a new standard.
itemCost.pending: A cost run for this item is still queued; the figures change when it completes.
itemCost.newStandardHint: The stock on hand is revalued to the new standard from its effective date, through the costing engine; the difference posts to the revaluation account.

itemEditor.costingOverrideHint: Leave on the company's method unless this item is costed differently.
itemEditor.costingLocked: The item has stock in this company; changing its method would re-value history.
itemEditor.factorHint: One of this unit holds numerator ÷ denominator of the base unit ({base}): a carton of 24 is 24 / 1, a dozen of a kilo item is 12 / 1.
itemEditor.barcodeHint: EAN-13, EAN-8 and UPC-A check digits are verified; a barcode belongs to one item only.
itemEditor.planningHint: What the replenishment planner reads for this item in each warehouse. Leave a figure empty when it does not apply.
itemEditor.noPlanning: No planning parameters in this company's warehouses.

branches.title: Branches
branches.hint: Each branch is also a value of the Branch dimension, so postings can be analysed by branch.
branches.name: Name

documentFlow.label: Related documents
documentFlow.truncated: Showing the documents of the first 50 orders.
documentFlow.nothingToReceive: Nothing is left to receive on this order.
documentFlow.nothingToInvoice: Nothing is left to invoice on this document.
documentFlow.nothingToReturn: Nothing is left to return on this receipt.

dimensions.description: The analysis axes that journals and documents carry — cost centre, department, project and any you add — and their values. Branch values come from the branches of each company.
dimensions.name: Name
dimensions.companyHint: Leave empty to use the value in every company.
dimensions.openHint: Double-click a dimension to see and edit its values.
dimensions.branchHint: Branch values are created and renamed with the branches on the Companies screen.
dimensions.noValuesHint: Add the cost centres, departments or projects that postings will carry.
dimensions.emptyDescription: Dimensions appear here as soon as the workspace is set up.

postingRules.description: Which account each posting lands on: every account role the documents post to is mapped onto an account of the company's chart, optionally only for a document type, posting group, warehouse or branch (the most specific rule wins). Profiles are versioned: a new version starts from the current rules and takes over when activated.
postingRules.unresolved: {count, plural, one {# role has no account} other {# roles have no account}}: postings that need them are refused until a rule is added.
postingRules.newVersionHint: The new version starts as a draft with a copy of the current rules; edit it, then activate it to take over from its valid-from date.
postingRules.editHint: One row per role and condition. Leave a condition on "any" to apply everywhere; a narrower rule wins over a general one.
postingRules.noChart: This company has no chart of accounts yet; create one first.
postingRules.noProfile: No posting profile yet. Create it from the chart: every role gets the chart's default account.
postingRules.groupsHint: Posting groups let items or partners post to different accounts (for example imported goods, or related-party customers). Assign a group to items and partners, then add rules for it.
postingRules.name: Name

units.description: The units of measure every item, price and stock quantity is expressed in, and the fixed conversions between units of one family.
units.name: Name
units.precisionHint: How many decimal places quantities in this unit keep (0 for pieces).
units.systemHint: System unit: its code and family are fixed
units.conversionsHint: Fixed factors between units of the same family. Packs and cartons differ by item and are set on each item's Units tab.
units.conversionFormHint: One from-unit equals numerator ÷ denominator to-units; the reverse is derived.
units.noPath: There is no conversion path between these units.
units.emptyDescription: Add the units your items are counted, weighed or measured in.

calendars.description: Fiscal calendars define the years and periods the books close by; business calendars define working days and holidays for due dates and lead times.
calendars.periodsPerYear: {count, plural, one {# period} other {# periods}} a year
calendars.addYearHint: The year's periods are created from the calendar. An open year takes postings at once; a future year is prepared but closed to postings until opened.
calendars.periodControlHint: Open, soft-close and close periods from Accounting → Periods.
calendars.name: Name
calendars.periodsHint: 12 monthly periods, or 13 with a closing adjustment period.
calendars.systemDaysHint: The system calendar's working days are fixed; create a business calendar to change them.
calendars.newBusinessHint: New calendars work Sunday to Thursday; adjust the days after creating it.

settings.description: Switches the modules read, per company or for the whole workspace, and the typed store behind them.

knownHints.accounting_journals_approval: When approval is required, a manual journal is submitted to a workflow before it posts.
knownHints.inventory_adjustments_approval: When approval is required, a stock adjustment is submitted to a workflow before it posts.

settings.none: No settings recorded; the defaults apply.
settings.invalidJson: The value is not valid JSON.

security.exceptionHint: The member keeps both permissions. The reason and who approved it are recorded in the audit trail; an end date makes sure the exception is reviewed.
security.revokeExceptionHint: From now on the conflict counts again: it shows in the report and, for a blocking rule, a new assignment that creates it is refused. The exception stays in the history with your reason.
security.groupClaimHint: The token claim that lists the member's groups, such as groups.
security.groupRolesHint: At each sign-in, a member in one of these groups is given the role mapped to it (roles are added, never removed).
security.invalidNetworks: Not an address or a CIDR range: {entries}
security.yourAddress: You are working from {address}; add it, or a range that covers it, to keep your access.
security.superUsersHint: Owners and members granted every permission are outside segregation of duties; keep this list short.
security.description: Segregation-of-duties rules, API keys for integrations, single sign-on and the workspace sign-in policy.
security.noConflicts: No member holds a conflicting pair of permissions.
security.ruleHint: A member who holds both permissions is flagged. Warn lets the assignment through with a warning; block refuses it.
security.keysHint: Keys let other systems call the API as you, limited to the scopes you choose. Revoke a key the moment it is no longer needed.
security.scopesHint: Permission keys separated by commas; leave empty to allow everything you can do.
security.ipAllowlistHint: IP addresses or CIDR ranges, separated by commas; empty allows any address.
security.keyOnce: Copy it now: it is shown only once and cannot be recovered.
security.ssoHint: Members sign in through your OpenID Connect provider. People with a matching email domain can be created on first sign-in.
security.authorityHint: The provider's issuer, such as https://login.example.com.
security.secretKept: Leave empty to keep the stored secret.
security.emailDomainsHint: Separated by commas, such as example.com.
security.policyHint: Applies to every member of the workspace. Changes take effect at each member's next sign-in or token refresh.

policyHints.sessionLifetimeHours: How long a member stays signed in without signing in again ({min}–{max}).
policyHints.stepUpWindowMinutes: Sensitive actions ask for the password again after this many minutes ({min}–{max}).
policyHints.mfaRequired: Members without an authenticator enrol one at their next sign-in.
policyHints.allowPasswordLogin: Turn off to make single sign-on the only way in.
policyHints.allowPasswordLoginNoSso: Password sign-in can be turned off once a single sign-on connection is active.
policyHints.ipAllowlist: One address or CIDR range per line, such as 203.0.113.7 or 10.0.0.0/8; leave empty to allow every network. Outside the list members cannot sign in and their sessions stop working. API keys have their own lists.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.description: This action needs a recent sign-in. Confirm your identity to continue; the action then completes.
stepUp.failed: Your identity could not be confirmed.

chartTools.importHint: Accounts are matched by code: new codes are created and existing ones updated. Use the export's columns; parents may come after their children. If one row is wrong nothing is imported and the reason is shown.
chartTools.mappingHint: Map each postable account to an account of the statutory chart used for statutory reporting. Only the rows you change are saved; choosing "not mapped" removes a mapping.
chartTools.unmapped: {count, plural, =0 {Every account is mapped} one {# account not mapped} other {# accounts not mapped}}

journalImport.title: Import journals
journalImport.hint: One row per journal line; rows with the same journal_ref form one journal. Every journal is created as a draft to review, submit and post as usual. If one row is wrong nothing is imported and the reason is shown.
journalImport.created: {count, plural, one {{formatted} draft journal created.} other {{formatted} draft journals created.}}

itemStructure.bomNotApplicable: Bills of material belong to kit and assembly items; change the item's type to give it one.
itemStructure.kitHint: A kit is sold as one item and its components leave stock when it ships; nothing is built.
itemStructure.assemblyHint: An assembly is built from its components: an assembly build consumes them and puts the assembly in stock at their cost.
itemStructure.activateOnSave: Make this version active when saved
itemStructure.unitHint: Empty for the component's base unit.
itemStructure.noAttributes: Variants combine attribute values such as size and colour; define the attributes first under "Categories, brands and attributes" on the items screen.
itemStructure.variantsHint: One SKU per combination of attribute values, each with its own name and status.
itemStructure.substitutesHint: Items that may replace this one when it is short, in order of preference.
itemStructure.valuesHint: Comma-separated, such as S, M, L.

numbering.description: Which series numbers which documents of a company: the template, the counters per period and the gapless audit. A document takes the most specific active series (branch, then fiscal year, then the default).
numbering.templateHint: Tokens: {company}, {branch}, {yy}, {yyyy}, {mm}, {fy}, and exactly one {seq} or {seq:N} (zero-padded to N digits).
numbering.noCounters: Nothing has been numbered from this series yet.
numbering.moveCounterHint: Moving forward skips numbers on purpose. Moving back needs the counter-reset permission and a reason, and never goes below a number already issued.
numbering.emptyDescription: Documents create a default series the first time they are numbered; add one here to choose your own format.

rates.description: Exchange rates by type and date; imported from providers or entered by hand.
rates.imported: {count, plural, one {# rate imported} other {# rates imported}}
rates.emptyDescription: Enter a rate or import from a provider.

members.ownerHint: The owner holds every permission whatever roles are assigned.
members.noAssignments: No roles assigned: this member can sign in but do nothing.
members.limitToHint: Tick one or more of each kind, or none to leave the role unlimited. A record is in reach when it belongs to a ticked company, a ticked branch and a ticked warehouse; a kind with nothing ticked does not limit.
members.blockedHint: Choose another role, or grant an exception for this member on the Security screen first.
members.description: Who can sign in, with which roles.
members.name: Name

roles.ownerLocked: The owner role holds every permission and cannot be changed.
roles.templateHint: Copies the permissions a typical job needs; edit them before saving.
roles.templatePending: {count, plural, one {# grant is} other {# grants are}} held back for modules not yet available:
roles.codeHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores; fixed once saved.
roles.conflicts: These permissions combine duties that should be segregated
roles.conflictsBlock: A blocking rule is tripped: saving will be refused. Remove one side of the pair.
roles.conflictsWarn: Warning rules only: the role can be saved, and members assigned it will be asked to acknowledge.
roles.fieldRulesHint: Hide a field or make it read-only for members with this role, such as the cost price on items.
roles.documentRulesHint: Allow or deny an action on one document type, such as approving purchase orders, on top of the permissions.
roles.fullAccessHint: Full access grants every permission, including those of modules added later, and sits outside segregation of duties. Keep it for owners.
roles.wholeModule: The whole module, including permissions added later
roles.reserved: Reserved for modules still to come
roles.reservedHint: These grants take effect when their module ships; they are kept as they are.
roles.description: Roles bundle permissions; the owner has every permission.
roles.name: Name

customFields.title: Custom fields
customFields.description: Fields your business needs on records; validated on every save and indexed when you say so.
customFields.keyHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores; cannot change later.
customFields.label: Label
customFields.indexedHint: Index this field for fast filtering
customFields.defaultValueHint: Filled in whenever a record is saved without a value for this field, including records the system creates.
customFields.positionHint: Fields are shown from the lowest number up.
customFields.activeHint: In use: shown on forms (a field taken out of use keeps the values already saved)
customFields.emptyDescription: Define a field and it appears on the record's form and in the API schema.

notifications.description: Your inbox and how you want to be notified.
notifications.emptyDescription: Mentions, announcements and assignments land here.

comments.title: {count, plural, =0 {Comments} other {Comments (#)}}

audit.description: Every change, who made it and when; tamper-evident.

detail.title: Audit event

outbox.title: Undelivered events (operators)
outbox.hint: An event the worker could not deliver holds back its record's later events. Retry it once the fault is fixed, or discard it with a reason when its effect is not wanted or was applied by hand.
outbox.discardHint: Its handlers will never run, and the later events of its record will be delivered. The reason and your name stay on the event.

empty.dead: No dead letters: every event was delivered or is still being tried.

webhooks.description: Send events to other systems; every delivery is signed and logged.

webhooks.eventTypesHint: Comma-separated: sales.invoice.posted, sales.*, or * for everything.
webhooks.secretOnce: Signing secret — copy it now; it will not be shown again.
webhooks.filtersHint: Optional, one per line as name=value: aggregateType=purchase_order, or any top-level field of the event's data such as companyId=…; an event is sent only when all of them match.
webhooks.emptyDescription: Add a webhook to receive events at your URL.

accounting.reasonHint: Required to reopen; kept in the audit trail
accounting.postingWindowsDescription: From/to dates for everyone or for a role; the engine refuses postings outside them.
accounting.noWindows: No windows: only the period states apply.

tracking.description: Every lot with its expiry and status and its trace forward and back; every serial with its timeline.

revaluations.postHint: Posting moves the difference between the inventory account and the write-down account, and re-applies any movements after the date.
revaluations.emptyDescription: Write stock down when it can no longer be sold at cost, or revalue it by hand.

valuation.description: What the stock is worth at any date by item and warehouse, equal to the inventory accounts; the cost runs the engine made.
valuation.emptyDescription: No stock is valued for these filters at this date.

workflow.inboxDescription: What waits for your decision: why it needs approval, which rule, which values, and everything that happened so far.

payables.unappliedReason: Unapplied from the open item screen

payables.emptyProposalsDescription: Propose what is due by a date.

openLines.description: What is still to arrive from suppliers: approved, sent and partly received order lines with goods open, valued at the net order price; late lines are flagged.
openLines.daysLate: {count, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}
openLines.summary: {lines, plural, =0 {No open lines} one {# open line} other {# open lines}}, {late, plural, =0 {none late} one {# late} other {# late}}
openLines.emptyDescription: Approved orders with goods still to receive appear here.

purchasing.returnsDescription: Goods sent back to the supplier from a posted receipt at the exact cost they came in with; GRNI carries the return until the supplier's debit note credits it; reversible while nothing has been credited.
purchasing.emptyReturnsDescription: Send back quantities of a posted receipt.
purchasing.nothingReturnable: Nothing of this receipt is left to return.
purchasing.chooseReceipt: Choose a posted receipt to see its lines.
purchasing.applyCreditHelp: Settle an open invoice of the same supplier with this debit note.
purchasing.landedCostsDescription: Freight, customs, duties, insurance and handling allocated to posted receipts by value, weight, volume or quantity: what is still on hand takes its share, what was already sold goes to cost of sales; estimates sit on the clearing account until the charge invoices settle them.
purchasing.emptyLandedCostsDescription: Land the charges of a shipment on its receipts.
purchasing.nothingAllocatable: No posted receipt lines to land on.
purchasing.invoicesDescription: Supplier invoices matched to receipts (three-way) and to service lines (two-way) or entered as expenses: breaches beyond the supplier's tolerances are blocked until an override, approval follows the workflow, posting settles GRNI, re-prices the stock, withholds tax and opens the payables.
purchasing.emptyInvoicesDescription: Enter the supplier's invoice against its receipts, its service lines or as an expense.
purchasing.nothingInvoicable: Nothing left to invoice for this supplier.
purchasing.notMatchedYet: Not matched yet; submit the invoice.
purchasing.noPayables: No payables until the invoice is posted.
purchasing.receiptsDescription: Goods received against purchase orders: within the supplier's tolerance, into stock at the expected cost with GRNI as the offset, reversed as a whole when they were wrong.
purchasing.emptyReceiptsDescription: Receive the open lines of an approved order.
purchasing.nothingReceivable: Nothing left to receive on this order.
purchasing.chooseOrder: Choose an order to see its open lines.
purchasing.requisitionsDescription: What departments need: lines with an item, a quantity, an estimate and a suggested supplier, approved through the workflow, then ordered per supplier.
purchasing.rfqsDescription: Lines sent to invited suppliers for pricing; quotes recorded, compared by landed price in the company's currency then lead time, and one awarded into a purchase order.
purchasing.ordersDescription: Purchase orders in the supplier's currency: submitted through the workflow, sent by email, changed through revisions that keep the previous version, cancelled or closed.
purchasing.agreementsDescription: Blanket agreements: agreed quantities and prices per item for a period; purchase orders release against them and never past the cap.
purchasing.noLines: No lines yet; add the first.
purchasing.emptyRequisitionsDescription: Raise the first requisition for what a department needs.
purchasing.emptyAgreementsDescription: Agree quantities and prices with a supplier for a period.
purchasing.committedAmountHelp: Zero leaves the value uncapped; only the line quantities cap releases.
purchasing.emptyOrdersDescription: Draft an order for a supplier, or create one from an approved requisition.
purchasing.noCommitments: No commitments until the order is approved.
purchasing.sendToHelp: Blank sends to the supplier's email address.
purchasing.emptyRfqsDescription: Send lines to suppliers and compare what they quote.
purchasing.title: Title
purchasing.comparisonNote: Ranked by landed total in {currency} at the spot rate of {date}, then by lead time.
